g.title: Halohydrin formation event 1
g.desc: CH₃CH=CH₂ + Br₂ → [CH₃CH–CH₂–Br]⁺ + Br⁻ Pi pair → Br; Br–Br pair → departing Br; attached Br lone pair closes bromonium bridge.

g.text: Pi pair → Br; Br–Br pair → departing Br; attached Br lone pair closes bromonium bridge.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Halohydrin formation event 2
g.desc: [CH₃CH–CH₂–Br]⁺ + H₂O → BrCH₂CH(OH₂⁺)CH₃ Water → more substituted bromonium C from backside; bridge C–Br pair → Br. Racemic product; no enantiomer selected.

g.text: Water → more substituted bromonium C from backside; bridge C–Br pair → Br. Racemic product; no enantiomer selected.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Halohydrin formation event 3
g.desc: BrCH₂CH(OH₂⁺)CH₃ + H₂O ⇌ BrCH₂CH(OH)CH₃ + H₃O⁺ Second water → oxonium H; oxonium O–H pair → O. Bromide spectator is omitted on both sides in events 2/3.

g.text: Second water → oxonium H; oxonium O–H pair → O. Bromide spectator is omitted on both sides in events 2/3.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
